response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial exposure (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS) and some low-latency, high-throughput backend work in D at Sociomantic. However, the role's core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) systems development — is only weakly met: C/C++ work dates to a single 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments and a university thesis project, and neither C++ nor Rust appears in the listed skills. Recent experience is predominantly TypeScript/Node full-stack and product work, with no routing, tiling, map data pipeline, or navigation guidance background. Worth a screening call given the GIS domain interest and demonstrated ability to learn new stacks, but the systems-language gap is substantial for a mid-senior IC expected to build production routing pipelines.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience via GISCollective and Green Map
Low-latency, high-volume service work (async I/O, caching, fibers) at Sociomantic
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, Linux/Docker/K8s
concerns: Modern C++ experience is dated (2014–2015) and Rust is absent
No routing, map-tiling, or navigation pipeline experience
Recent roles are full-stack TypeScript/Node, not systems engineering
